1 3. Petitioner-Shubham a l i a s Shivam Gautam bears Aadhar Card No.3446 7350 6189,
prosecutrix/respondent No.2 bears Aadhar Card No.7308 1226 9413 & respondent No.3-Smt. Geeta Rohtak (mother of prosecutrix) bears Aadhar Card No.8897 5060 4051.
4.
At the outset, prosecutrix/respondent No.2 and petitioner informed this Court that both of them entered into wedlock and both are living together as legally wedded couple.

Out of their wedlock,
they are also blessed with two children (twins).
They want to settle the matter because prosecutrix does not want to prosecute the case and she is happily living in matrimonial fold with petitioner.
This Court verified the Aadhar Card of prosecutrix and petitioner and matched the same with the verification report submitted by Principal Registrar of this Court.

For this purpose, petitioner and prosecutrix filed separate applications I.A. No.5447/20225 & I.A. No.5448/2025 under Section 359 (1) & 359 (2) of BNSS respectively for compounding of offence for settlement.
Affidavits of prosecutrix and petitioner are also on record in this regard.

5. Smt. Geeta Rohtak/respondent No.3(mother of prosecutrix), Shri Rakesh Rohtak (father of prosecutrix) & Smt. Mainda Gautam (mother of petitioner) who are also present in person, endorsed the fact regarding settlement and submit that petitioner and prosecutrix are living together as happily married couple.
6. Both the parties (petitioners and prosecutrix) appeared before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 04/04/2025 for verification of compromise.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10380 3 MCRC-11104-2025 7.

The factum of compromise entered into between the parties has been verified by the Principal Registrar of this Court and according to the verification report, the parties settled the matter and intended to compromise the matter.
They want to live together as legally wedded couple.

8. Prosecutrix/respondent No.2 herself appeared before this Court and after verifying her identity from matching the Aadhar Card Number with Aadhar Card Number filed at the time of verification before Principal Registrar of this Court, this Court came to the conclusion that identity of the complainant is proper and she wants to settle the matter because she is legally wedded wife of petitioner - Shubham alias Shivam Gautam.
9. Fact remains that petitioner and prosecutrix are married couple.
It is regular and easy to be retributive but at the same time a Judge has to sublimely feel the pulse of the case.

One cannot forget that "Every "F I L E"
with same alphabets, contains a "L I F E".

(See : In Re State of Madhya Pradesh Vs.
Pankaj Mishra, 2021 SCC OnLine MP 5480 and Geeta Paliwal and others Vs. Sitaram and others reported as 2023 SCC Online MP 811.).
